title: Spunchbub lua
script:
-- when the:
if getgenv()["spunch_loaded"] then return end
getgenv()["spunch_loaded"] = true
if not setmetatable then warn("[spunch]: Unsupported executor!") return end
if not setfenv then warn("[spunch]: Unsupported executor!") return end
if not loadstring then warn("[spunch]: Unsupported executor!") return end
if not writefile then warn("[spunch]: Unsupported executor!") return end
if not delfile then warn("[spunch]: Unsupported executor!") return end
if not getcustomasset then warn("[spunch]: Unsupported executor!") return end
if not cloneref then warn("[spunch]: Unsupported executor") return end
local CoreGui = cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui"))
local filename = "spunch.rbxm"
local url = "https://github.com/WeLoveBackdoors/clientsided-spunch/raw/refs/heads/main/spunch.rbxm"

writefile(filename, game:HttpGet(url))

local gui = game:GetObjects(getcustomasset(filename))[1]

delfile(filename)

if gethui or get_hidden_gui then
    local hiddenui = get_hidden_gui or gethui
    gui.Parent = hiddenui()
elseif CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui") then 
    gui.Parent = CoreGui.RobloxGui
else
    gui.Parent = CoreGui
end

gui.DisplayOrder = 2147483647
gui.Name = "spunchbub"

for _, v in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
    if v:IsA("LocalScript") then
        local fn = loadstring(v.Source)
        setfenv(fn, setmetatable({ script = v }, { __index = getfenv() }))
        task.spawn(fn)
    elseif v:IsA("GuiObject") then
        v.ZIndex = 2147483647
    end
end
